records.what_it_does: Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 190 million to the Ministry of Agrarian Development and Family Agriculture. Funds emergency actions supporting family agriculture.
records.relevant_ministry: Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar

records.what_it_does: Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 230.38 million to the Ministry of Development and Social Assistance. Funds food and nutritional security actions for families affected by emergency or public calamity situations.
records.relevant_ministry: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social

records.what_it_does: Modifies Law 10,779/2003 regarding unemployment insurance for artisanal fishermen during closed fishing seasons. Transfers administration of benefits from INSS to Ministry of Labor and Employment.
Authorizes extension of fixed-term employment contracts within IBGE Foundation. Also covers Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services.
records.relevant_ministry: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos

records.what_it_does: Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 2.5 million to Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. Combats cassava crop disease known as witches' broom or descending death plague.
Opens extraordinary credit for combating cassava witches' broom disease affecting indigenous peoples and quilombola communities. Targets family farmers in states of Amapá and Pará.
Modifies Law 15,211 regarding effective date of Digital Child and Adolescent Statute. Adjusts implementation timeline for digital protection regulations.
Institutes Special Tax Regime for Datacenter Services (REDATA). Creates tax incentives for datacenter infrastructure development in Brazil.
Amends regulations to establish National Data Protection Agency (ANPD). Strengthens data privacy governance framework.
Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 12 billion for official credit operations. Creates rural credit line for debt settlement and amortization.
Expands tax depreciation benefit limits for maritime vessels. Covers tanker ships and offshore support vessels.
Authorizes use of financial surplus as resources for rural credit lines. Enables debt settlement or amortization for rural producers affected by adverse events.
Changes denomination of Auxílio Gás and establishes new operational mode. Adjusts gas subsidy program for low-income families.
records.relevant_ministry: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social

records.what_it_does: Opens extraordinary credit for agricultural emergency prevention and combat. Funds Ministry of Agriculture phytosanitary response programs.
Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 30.59 million for phytosanitary emergency response. Addresses plant health crises in states of Amapá and Pará.
records.relevant_ministry: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social

records.what_it_does: Opens extraordinary credit of R$ 30 billion for Union financial charges. Allocates funds for Sovereign Brazil Plan (Plano Brasil Soberano) infrastructure investments.
Establishes committee for Sovereign Brazil Plan (Plano Brasil Soberano). Creates framework for managing commercial relations with United States.

Institutes Special Environmental Licensing (LAE) framework for strategic activities and enterprises. Streamlines approval process for infrastructure projects classified as strategic national interest.
